Maker does not publish dimensions/weight/speed/runtime; aggregator figures (92 cm, 40.8 kg, 4 h) left out. Volume capacity only, no kg payload stated.

name: FlashBot

Payload left blank because per-layer vs total differs by generation.

Succeeded by R3 (unveiled 2022) and Nuro has since pivoted to licensing its Nuro Driver software; maker does not state R2 is discontinued, so status left blank. release_year 2020 is from Nuro's Feb 2020 R2 announcement blog (seen in search index, not re-opened).

No Camello-specific maker figure for height, weight or payload could be verified, so those fields stay empty (search-index copies: 20 kg load, 5 km/h, 100 L, ~6 h). Original Camello entered a one-year Punggol (Singapore) trial in Feb 2021. Status not stated by maker (likely superseded by Camello+).
